featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience with the Summer Camp at Go Figure Fitness, Kalina. Ivaan thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of the camp and looked forward to attending each day.

The variety of activities kept the children engaged and excited throughout the program. From art and craft sessions, pottery, water play, speech and drama, to planting trees and other creative activities, every day offered something new and enriching. We especially appreciated the balance of fun, creativity, learning, and physical activity.

The organizers and instructors were warm, encouraging, and attentive, creating a safe and positive environment for the children. It was lovely to see Ivaan come home each day with new experiences, stories, and creations to share.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a member of the gym for months. When I joined, I was shown a free area upstairs for posing and yoga, but suddenly it has become restricted to women and trainers only. Who is responsible for this change?

I joined this gym specifically because of that space — I’m quite introverted, and I prefer to exercise in a quiet environment. I also run an Instagram page with over 400k followers focused mainly on bodybuilding content, so having a private area for posing is important for me. This change was never communicated to anyone.

I absolutely respect that the space is now being used for the benefit of women, but in that case, I believe men should also have access to a similar area.

Additionally, the washrooms and sauna are in very poor condition. The sauna is in terrible shape, and the washrooms — both upstairs and downstairs — have a very strong unpleasant smell. Cleanliness does not seem to be a priority at all.

featured_reviews.name: Tarun Patnaik
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the best gym in the locality. It’s well-equipped with almost everything you need and quite spacious. The staff and trainers are friendly and professional, making the experience pleasant. The membership packages are also reasonably priced. Additionally, the gym has an app that’s quite helpful. However, it can get a bit crowded during peak hours. The personal training program includes 12 weight training sessions and 12 cardio sessions per month, which wasn't exactly what I was looking for, as I wanted a plan focused solely on weight training. Despite that, I had a great experience overall.
